title: P18.3 Supervisor Collection Liveness & Autonomous Recovery — state-independent collect, deferred recovery, unconditional codex adapter, executor-completion wake, liveness stamps
description: Forensic root cause (docs/p18-3/P18_3_FORENSIC_ROOT_CAUSE.md): a codex execution could sit RUNNING ~63min after result.json because (RC-A) applyPendingRecovery applied under state=RUNNING while its close-out required RECOVERING, so pending_recovery never cleared and every tick early-returned before observe (task version=7507 ≈ 2 writes/tick over the stall); (RC-B) observe/collect/settle only ran inside runRunning so RECOVERING/WAITING_BACKOFF/WAITING_APPROVAL starved sibling executions; (RC-C) CODEX_HOME-env-gated adapter registration made adapterFor null after restart -> UNKNOWN_SIDE_EFFECT_STATE re-probe every 30s forever; (RC-D) no executor->supervisor completion signal existed. Fix: tick() hoists a state-independent collect loop over COLLECT_LIVE_STATES selecting unsettled (!result) executions; pending recovery transitions runtime to RECOVERING before apply (RC-A closed) and concurrent failures defer via deferred_recovery instead of clobbering; codex adapter registers unconditionally while qualify() still gates dispatch (RC-C); adapters emit onFinished after durable terminal evidence and serve-mission-control wires it to sup.wake(EXECUTOR_COMPLETION) as a best-effort hint — the bounded 1s sweep remains the settlement authority (RC-D). Orphan/unobservable re-probes are capped (40) with one durable EXECUTION_ORPHAN_UNOBSERVABLE event. Liveness stamps on executor_execution: first_terminal_observed_at, collection_started_at/committed_at/attempts, settled_at, observe_count, finished_at (executor-side) inside last_observation; surfaced via missionSummary.executions + observability metrics. A thrown collect leaves durable attempt evidence and the row stays eligible for idempotent retry; settled rows are never re-collected (exactly-once). Also: PLANNER_VALIDATION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED dedup keyed on the episode's last planner run, and win32 test-harness fixes (fileURLToPath ESM specifier, node+tsx spawn) with zero production behavior change.
